meta.note: Supermarket locations and hours are approximate. Always verify opening hours on the chain's website or app — hours can change for public holidays, COVID-affected periods, and Anzac Day (typically closed morning, open from 1pm).

stores.name: Woolworths Surfers Paradise
stores.address: 10-14 Ferny Ave, Surfers Paradise QLD 4217 (near Chevron Renaissance)
stores.notes: Full supermarket. Short walk from central Surfers accommodation. Good for a full grocery shop.

stores.name: Woolworths Broadbeach (The Oasis)
stores.address: The Oasis Shopping Centre, 75 Surf Parade, Broadbeach QLD 4218
stores.notes: Inside The Oasis centre. Walk from Broadbeach hotels. Close to Kurrawa Beach.

stores.name: Woolworths Southport (Australia Fair)
stores.address: Australia Fair Shopping Centre, 42 Marine Parade, Southport QLD 4215
stores.notes: Inside Australia Fair shopping centre. Short drive from Southport/Labrador area. Near Broadwater Parklands.

stores.name: Woolworths The Pines (Elanora)
stores.address: The Pines Shopping Centre, Guineas Creek Rd, Elanora QLD 4221
stores.notes: Best Woolworths near Coolangatta area (~10 min drive). Full supermarket with everything you need.

stores.name: Woolworths Burleigh Heads
stores.address: Stockland Burleigh Heads, 149 W Burleigh Rd, Burleigh Waters QLD 4220
stores.notes: Inside Stockland Burleigh. 5 min drive from Burleigh beach. Good for stocking up.

stores.name: Coles Surfers Paradise
stores.address: Gold Coast Hwy & Elkhorn Ave, Surfers Paradise QLD 4217
stores.notes: Central Surfers, right on the highway. Larger Coles with everything. Late-night hours — open till 10pm.

stores.name: Coles Pacific Fair
stores.address: Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, Hooker Blvd, Broadbeach Waters QLD 4218
stores.notes: Inside Pacific Fair. Huge Coles. Combine groceries with shopping, food court, playgrounds. Ideal family stop.

stores.name: Coles Coolangatta (The Strand)
stores.address: The Strand, 72-80 Marine Parade, Coolangatta QLD 4225
stores.notes: At The Strand shopping centre. Walk from Coolangatta accommodation. Compact but well-stocked.

stores.name: Coles Burleigh Heads
stores.address: Stockland Burleigh Heads, 149 W Burleigh Rd, Burleigh Waters QLD 4220
stores.notes: Inside Stockland Burleigh (same centre as Woolworths — pick your preferred). Good range.

stores.name: ALDI Southport
stores.address: 127-129 Ferry Rd, Southport QLD 4215
stores.notes: Cheapest option by far. Limited but excellent range of own-brand essentials. You'd be surprised what you can get.

stores.name: ALDI Mermaid Waters
stores.address: Q Super Centre, Markeri St & Bermuda St, Mermaid Waters QLD 4218
stores.notes: Inside Q Super Centre. Between Broadbeach and Burleigh. Great for budget grocery runs.

stores.name: ALDI Burleigh Waters
stores.address: West Burleigh Rd, Burleigh Waters QLD 4220 (near Stockland)
stores.notes: Close to Burleigh accommodation. Budget-friendly. Remember to bring or buy bags (ALDI doesn't give free bags).

stores.name: ALDI Robina
stores.address: Robina Town Centre Dr, Robina QLD 4226 (near Robina Town Centre)
stores.notes: Near Robina Town Centre. Good pit-stop if exploring the central/suburban GC.

stores.name: IGA Broadbeach
stores.address: 26-28 Queensland Ave, Broadbeach QLD 4218
stores.notes: Convenient smaller supermarket. Walking distance from Broadbeach hotels. Great for quick top-ups.

stores.name: IGA Miami / Burleigh
stores.address: 1934 Gold Coast Hwy, Miami QLD 4220 (between Burleigh and Mermaid)
stores.notes: Good midway supermarket between Burleigh and Broadbeach. Independent, great range of local products.

stores.name: IGA Coolangatta
stores.address: Musgrave St & Marine Parade, Coolangatta QLD 4225
stores.notes: Walkable from Coolangatta holiday apartments. Good for quick supplies without driving.

stores.name: IGA Mermaid Park
stores.address: Shop 2, 2541 Gold Coast Hwy, Mermaid Beach QLD 4218
stores.notes: Small but well-stocked local IGA. Near Mermaid Beach accommodation. Good for essentials.

stores.name: FoodWorks Labrador
stores.address: 100 Brisbane Rd, Labrador QLD 4215
stores.notes: Local FoodWorks in Labrador. Good alternative to the big chains. Reasonable prices, community-focused.

stores.name: FoodWorks Mermaid Beach
stores.address: 2350 Gold Coast Hwy, Mermaid Beach QLD 4218
stores.notes: Handy roadside FoodWorks on the highway. Convenient stop if driving along the coastal strip.

stores.name: SPAR Carrara
stores.address: Carrara Markets precinct, Gooding Dr, Carrara QLD 4211
stores.notes: SPAR convenience supermarket near Carrara Markets. Smaller range but good for quick supplies. Open Sundays.

stores.name: Coles Southport Park
stores.address: Southport Park Shopping Centre, 163-171 Ferry Rd, Southport QLD 4215
stores.notes: Well-stocked Coles at Southport Park. Easy parking. Good for families staying in Southport/Labrador area.

stores.name: Woolworths Robina Town Centre
stores.address: Robina Town Centre, Robina Town Centre Dr, Robina QLD 4226
stores.notes: Inside Robina Town Centre. Massive shopping centre — combine groceries with entertainment, cinema, dining. Good indoor option on hot/rainy days.
